SELECT CU.ROOM_ID AS roomId , U.USER_ID AS userId , U.NAME AS "user.name" , CU.IS_ACTIVE AS isActive , U.EMAIL AS "user.email" FROM GROUVY_CHAT_ROOMS R, GROUVY_CHAT_ROOM_USERS CU, GROUVY_USERS U WHERE R.ROOM_ID = CU.ROOM_ID AND U.USER_ID = CU.USER_ID AND R.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT M.CHAT_MESSAGE_ID AS chatMessageId , M.ROOM_ID AS roomId , M.SENDER_ID AS senderId , M.CHAT_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS content , M.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType , M.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , U.NAME AS "user.name" , U.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS "user.profileImgPath" , R.ROOM_NAME AS "chatRoom.roomName" , R.IS_GROUP AS "chatRoom.isGroup" FROM GROUVY_CHAT_MESSAGES M, GROUVY_USERS U, GROUVY_CHAT_ROOMS R WHERE M.SENDER_ID = U.USER_ID AND M.ROOM_ID = R.ROOM_ID AND M.CHAT_MESSAGE_ID = #{chatMessageId}

SELECT M.CHAT_MESSAGE_ID AS chatMessageId , M.ROOM_ID AS roomId , M.SENDER_ID AS senderId , M.CHAT_MESSAGE_CONTENT AS content , M.CHAT_MESSAGE_TYPE AS messageType , M.CREATED_DATE AS createdDate , U.NAME AS "user.name" , U.PROFILE_IMG_PATH AS "user.profileImgPath" , R.ROOM_NAME AS "chatRoom.roomName" , R.IS_GROUP AS "chatRoom.isGroup" FROM GROUVY_CHAT_MESSAGES M, GROUVY_USERS U, GROUVY_CHAT_ROOMS R WHERE U.USER_ID = M.SENDER_ID AND R.ROOM_ID = M.ROOM_ID AND M.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND M.CREATED_DATE >= (SELECT JOIN_DATE FROM GROUVY_CHAT_ROOM_USERS WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}) ORDER BY M.CREATED_DATE ASC
